name: Monroe Murders
source:
You play as a barista, who begins to get too close to something more dangerous than they had bargained for when building an innocent love connection between two acquaintances leads you closer to uncovering the truth of the Monroe Murders.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名咖啡师，在两个熟人之间建立起无辜的爱情关系，让你更接近揭开门罗谋杀案的真相时，他开始接触比他们预想的更危险的东西。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043890/]Steam[/url]]
